detail.longDescription:
Photo Restore Scan brings a home screen launcher and file management tools together on your Android device.
MAKE YOUR HOME SCREEN YOUR STARTING POINT Choose Photo Restore Scan as your default home app to browse your apps, search your app list, arrange shortcuts in folders and use widgets. Swipe right from the launcher to open the file tools dashboard.
FIND AND REVIEW ACCESSIBLE FILES Scan accessible shared storage for photos, videos, audio and documents. Browse results by file type, preview supported media, and use sorting and date filters to review what you find.
ORGANIZE SELECTED FILES Use the recovery action to move selected, readable files into categorized folders in the Recovered directory. Open Recovered Files to review files stored there, or delete selected files you no longer need.
REVIEW SCREENSHOTS AND CLEANABLE FILES Browse detected screenshots and select items to remove. Review accessible temporary files, logs and other detected cleanup items before cleaning. Available results depend on your Android version, storage permissions and accessible folders.
VIEW DEVICE INFORMATION Open Device Status to review device and storage information alongside your file tools.
PERMISSIONS AND LIMITATIONS File scanning and management require storage access. On supported Android versions, these features request All files access to work across accessible shared-storage folders. The home screen experience requires selecting Photo Restore Scan as your default launcher.
The recovery feature works with files that still exist and can be read on your device. It does not reconstruct files that have been permanently deleted or overwritten. Moving a file changes its original location. Results depend on the files available on your device and the access Android allows.
The app contains ads. An internet connection is used for advertising, app configuration and analytics services.
